items.title: Newsmax Fears Fox Freeze-Out on Roku if Merger Is Not Blocked
items.title_zh: Newsmax 担心如果合并不被阻止，Fox 将在 Roku 上被冻结
items.summary: Newsmax filed an antitrust lawsuit on Thursday that seeks to block the Fox-Roku merger, arguing that the deal gives Fox unlawful monopoly power over the free streaming market. Fox Corp. closed the $22 billion acquisition earlier this month.
items.summary_zh: Newsmax 周四提起反垄断诉讼，试图阻止 Fox 与 Roku 的合并，称该交易赋予 Fox 对免费流媒体市场的非法垄断权。福克斯公司本月早些时候完成了价值 220 亿美元的收购。

items.title: 'Parasite' backer and other South Korean media, gaming and travel stocks rally on China trade deal
items.title_zh: 《寄生虫》支持者和其他韩国媒体、游戏和旅游股因中国贸易协议而上涨
items.summary: Korean media, gaming and travel stocks surged on hopes of greater access to China.
items.summary_zh: 由于希望更多地进入中国市场，韩国媒体、游戏和旅游股飙升。

items.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending
items.title_zh: 马斯克表示黄仁勋是不可替代的，对中期支出感到遗憾
items.summary: Elon Musk spoke about Jensen Huang, his U.S. midterms spending and overlaps between SpaceX and Tesla at the Dealbook Summit.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克在 Dealbook 峰会上谈到了黄仁勋、他的美国中期支出以及 SpaceX 和特斯拉之间的重叠。

items.title: Taylor Swift Performs ‘I Knew It, I Knew You’ and ‘Our Song’ Mashup at CMA Awards
items.title_zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在 CMA 颁奖典礼上表演《我知道，我知道你》和《我们的歌》混搭
items.summary: “It’s been a while,” Taylor Swift sang during her performance of “I Knew It, I Knew You” at the Country Music Association Awards on Wednesday night — and it sure was, marking her first time performing at the show in 13 years.
items.summary_zh: “已经有一段时间了，”周三晚上，泰勒·斯威夫特在乡村音乐协会颁奖典礼上表演《我知道，我知道你》时唱道，这确实是她 13 年来首次在该演出中表演。

items.title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克试图解释乌克兰和星链的情况
items.summary: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 表示，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基 (Volodymyr Zelenskyy) 在乌克兰的 Starshield 中断问题上撒了谎，并且他试图滥用 SpaceX 的消费者服务 Starlink 来用于军事目的。

items.title: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 筹集超过 810 亿美元，创历史最大发行规模，超过 SpaceX
items.summary: Anthropic stock is set to begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ANT on Thursday.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 股票将于周四开始在纳斯达克交易，股票代码为 ANT。

items.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
items.title_zh: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 解释为何要求 6 万名员工辞职
items.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explained why he offered buyouts to 60,000 of his employees in October, essentially urging them to voluntarily quit, rather than reducing the workforce via another massive layoff. The short answer is AI, but not in the way you might expect.
items.summary_zh: 微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 解释了为什么他在 10 月份向 6 万名员工提出买断，实质上是敦促他们自愿辞职，而不是通过另一次大规模裁员来减少员工数量。简而言之，答案是人工智能，但不是以你想象的方式。

items.title: Elon Musk says: ‘I’m not MAGA’
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克说：“我不是 MAGA”
items.summary: During his appearance Wednesday at The New York Times' DealBook Summit, Elon Musk said that he wasn't sure what the term "MAGA" meant and also commented that he felt "pretty foolish" for having spent so much money during the U.S. midterms.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克周三出席《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会时表示，他不确定“MAGA”一词的含义，并表示他觉得在美国中期选举期间花了这么多钱“非常愚蠢”。
